goal: Stop recording blocks as durable on disk when flushing block or undo data files fails
Prevent index metadata and coins cache updates from committing ahead of underlying block data
agreement: Strong support for propagating flush errors to prevent metadata advancing ahead of block data
Concept approval noting corruption risk when block files are stored on a separate disk (mzumsande)
Verified by running unit tests and checking that tests fail without the fix (arejula27, optout21)
Tested while investigating kernel pruning changes (pzafonte)
Open question on whether flush retries are expected after shutdown (arejula27)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it prevents chainstate corruption when block or undo file flushes fail
Stops index metadata and coins cache from committing ahead of actual block data on disk
Particularly avoids silent corruption when blocks are stored on a separate filesystem
